scope.logic_trader: Selection, composition and evaluation of logical assets only.

mandatory_semantic_rules.description: SAT means encoded constraints are satisfiable; it is not a natural-language truth judgement.
For a formal encoding, test premises ∧ ¬conclusion for UNSAT; check premises consistency separately.
A proof is relative to its formal assumptions; source authenticity and empirical correctness are separate checks.
ProbLog computes query probabilities relative to the supplied probabilistic logic program.
Active inference needs an explicit generative model and state/action/observation definition.
Organism-to-agent responsibility mappings must be tested against task data.
Self-similarity alone does not establish logical correctness.

acceptance_gates: Matrix and configs pass schema/integrity validation.

The canonical propositional adapter and typed AST complement distinguish SAT/UNSAT/UNKNOWN, separate premise consistency from entailment, require source refs or explicit assumptions, and never auto-promote truth.
At least 30 source-grounded negative, boundary or counterexample cases exist before any model release.
Current lexical-ranking baseline is measured for precision/recall at K, false selections and provenance coverage.
Candidate variants cannot change source records, policy gates, formal premises or be promoted by their own score; unformalized Logic Trader candidates remain queued.
Network sync remains disabled until peer auth, replay protection and partition tests pass.
Each connectome track has a pinned dataset manifest and task benchmark before agent integration.
Source-grounded benchmark intake validates exact source references/spans, keeps unformalized prose out of the solver, and remains blocked with null metrics until reviewed cases meet all thresholds.
